newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty slightly firmer vs basket, depos stable.
newsitem.headline: Zloty slightly firmer vs basket, depos stable.

text.p: The Polish zloty firmed slightly against the basket of currnecies, in line with the dollar's fall to the mark on world markets, and was seen holding under resistance at three percent from parity on Friday.
"With no larger client orders the zloty is seen adjusting to the dollar's slip agaist the mark, which may cause it to firm lightly against parity, said Tomasz Wolosz from BRE SA.

Some dealers also said the zloty's upward movements were also caused by expected foreign investor payments for fixed bonds bought at Wednesday's auction. Foreigners bought roughly $40 million at the tender.
At 0920 the zloty was quoted at 2.95/2.91 percent from the trading band centre, stronger than opening's 2.90/2.86 percent.
It was at 3.0860/70 to the dollar, up from opening's 3.0895/15 and at 1.8000/10 to the mark, down from 1.7995/00.
One-day deposits were stable on a generally balanced market after the central bank refrained from staging any open marekt operations on Friday.

Overnight rates inched up from opening levels by 0.05 point to 21.70/21.90 percent ahead of the weekend, tomorrow/next rates were at 21.75/21.90 percent, around Thursday's 21.74/21.99 percent. -- Krzysztof Wojcik +48 22 653 9700
